speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Don't make this hard for me.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: It's not hard. It's simple. You can either sit with me, your friend, colleague and roommate, or you can sit with an overrated scientist you might have sex with.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: You're right, it is simple.

speaker: penny
text: Hey, Sheldon. Third floor tonight. Mixing it up?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Penny.

speaker: penny
text: Oh. You know, I still don't understand why you just don't go to dinner or something.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Alright, let's say I go to dinner alone. And during the meal I have to use the rest room. How do I know someone's not touching my food?

speaker: penny
text: Goodnight Sheldon.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Penny, hold on. Are you sure things can't work out with you and Leonard? I'm just wondering if you really gave it the old college try? Or in your case the old community college try?

speaker: penny
text: Excuse me?

speaker: penny
text: Okay, where is this coming from?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Leonard is upstairs right now with my arch enemy.

speaker: penny
text: Your arch enemy?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Yes, the Doctor Doom to my Mr Fantastic. The Doctor Octopus to my Spiderman. The Doctor Sivana to my Captain Marvel. Do you know, it's amazing how many supervillains have advanced degrees. Graduate school should probably do a better job of screening those people out.

speaker: penny
text: Okay, I get it, I get it, I get it.

speaker: penny
text: Sheldon, come back, you're losing me.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Leslie Winkle, Penny. She belittles my research.

speaker: penny
text: Oh, sweetie, I'm sorry.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: She called me dumbass.

speaker: penny
text: I know. I heard.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Given this situation, I have no choice but to withdraw my previous objections to your ill considered relationship with Leonard.

speaker: penny
text: Oh, gee, well, thankyou for that. But, um, I think for now Leonard and I are just going to stay friends.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: No, that response is unacceptable to me.

speaker: penny
text: Sheldon, you are a smart guy, you must know...

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Smart? I'd have to lose 60 IQ points to be classified as smart.

speaker: penny
text: Are you going to let me talk?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I'm sorry.

speaker: penny
text: You must know that if Leonard and Leslie want to be together, nothing you can do is going to stop it.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You continue to underestimate my abilities madam.

speaker: penny
text: Okay, let me put it this way, if you're really Leonard's friend you will support him no matter who he wants to be with.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Wait a minute, why am I doing all the giving here? If Leonard's really my friend, why doesn't he have to support me in my hatred of Leslie Winkle?

speaker: penny
text: Because love trumps hate.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh now you're just making stuff up.

speaker: penny
text: Okay. Goodnight Sheldon.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh Mario. If only I could control everyone the way I control you. Hop, you little plumber, hop, hop, hop.
